title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE CO-OP HUNT FIXES
why: The card was stamped v21.68 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names the high fixes from the second whole-game hunt of 2026-10-09; the rest are in the change list.
now: The what is new card names the co-op hunt fixes.
